title: Membership-Term Shares for Ensemble Members Joining after the First Rehearsal, 2026-27 Fine Arts Fee Schedule (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Membership-term share.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the 2026-27 Fine Arts fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** applies a membership-term share by the registration date. Schedule dates: first rehearsal 2026-08-03; spring semester start 2027-01-04; last day 2027-05-27; the year counts 40 weeks.

- A registration date on or after 2027-01-04 pays the spring-semester share, a flat 50 percent.
- A registration date more than 28 calendar days after 2026-08-03 but before 2027-01-04 is prorated by whole weeks: the whole weeks from the registration date to 2027-05-27 out of 40, as a percentage never above 100.
- Any other registration date pays the full-year share (100 percent).

Whole weeks are the calendar days from the registration date to 2027-05-27 divided by 7 with any part week dropped.

## Input, judgement, share (hypothetical registration dates)

| Registration date | Days after 2026-08-03 | Judgement | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-20 | 17 | not more than 28 days | 100 percent |
| 2026-08-31 | 28 | not more than 28 days | 100 percent |
| 2026-09-01 | 29 | prorated, 268 days, 38 whole weeks | 95 percent |
| 2026-10-14 | 72 | prorated, 225 days, 32 whole weeks | 80 percent |
| 2027-02-09 | after 2027-01-04 | spring-semester share | 50 percent |
